verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of Snowflake letting users choose a region or data-residency location for their account or data. Iceberg tables using customer-managed external cloud storage are a different feature (open table format and storage ownership), not a region or residency control. A trial user's passing mention of an AWS US East account does not document a selection capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
